newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close lower on loose funds.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close lower on loose funds.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended lower on Wednesday despite the central bank's issuance of negotiable certificates of deposit for the second straight day to mop up excess liquidity, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate closed at 5.009 percent against Tuesday's 5.048 finish, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.05-5.10 against 5.10.
The central bank said it did not rule out the possibility of issuing more NCDs on Thursday to prevent the money rates from sliding below the 5.00 percent level.
The newly auctioned 10-year 86/4 government bond was the focus of the bond market. The bond yield was at 6.1275 in early session. No trade was reported in the afternoon.
